purpose: Diagnostic only: quantify two-expert complementarity and gate selection using frozen three-seed summaries. Oracle accuracy uses the true label and is not deployable.

metric_definitions.direct_accuracy: Accuracy of the direct four-role expert.
metric_definitions.mapped_accuracy: Accuracy after mapping the 17-species posterior into four roles.
metric_definitions.fused_accuracy: Accuracy of the learned convex fusion after the complete RSG model.
metric_definitions.oracle_accuracy: Per-image correctness if the better of two experts were selected using the true label; diagnostic upper bound only.
metric_definitions.expert_prediction_disagreement_rate: Rate at which the direct and mapped role argmax predictions differ.
metric_definitions.one_right_one_wrong_rate: Rate at which exactly one expert predicts the true role.
metric_definitions.one_right_gate_selection_accuracy: Gate correctness conditional on the one-right / one-wrong subset.
